title: The Local AI Stack — Data API v1 (Crucible benchmarks)
description: Formal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the Crucible benchmark-thread dataset published at /data/api/v1/benchmarks.json (and the unversioned copy at /data/benchmarks.json). Two-pass parse of the forum thread: pass 1 keyword-matches relevant posts; pass 2 extracts structured fields from the post's own text (quoted content excluded). Extraction is conservative — a field the post does not state is null, never guessed; every item keeps a 300-char preview as the fallback. See /data/api/README.md for the full contract and changelog.

version.description: Data API version (major.minor). Present on the published /data/api/v1/ copy; absent on the repo-root /data/benchmarks.json copy.

source.description: Display name of the source thread.

count.description: Number of records in 'items'. Must equal len(items).

items.description: One record per relevant thread post.

post_id.description: The Discourse post id (for deep links to the source post).

post_number.description: The post's number within the thread.

contributor.description: The forum username of the post's author.

model.description: The LLM model being benchmarked (verbatim, e.g. 'Qwen 3.8 flash next'). null when the post does not name a specific model — a bare family name with no version signal is rejected, never padded.

hardware.description: The GPU as stated (with count when stated, e.g. '4x 9700 Pro'). null when not confidently the poster's own card — questions, hypotheticals, and envy are never treated as specs.

backend.description: The poster's inference engine (vLLM, vllm-radiance, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, SGLang, Radiance, Unsloth, TGI, Colibri, LiteLLM). null for capability lists ('If you're running vLLM, llama.cpp, ...') and parenthetical asides.

performance.description: Measured performance. Labeled figures only: a speed number counts when its sentence names the metric (decode / prefill / generation / eval / TTFT). Inequality thresholds (a '>= 30 tokens/sec' design target) and unlabeled examples are not measurements.

decode_tps.description: Decode speed as reported (leading number parseable; ranges like '80-100' kept verbatim). null when not reported.

prefill_tps.description: Prefill speed as reported. null when not reported.

vram_gb.description: VRAM usage in GB, as reported. null when not reported.

ttft_s.description: Time to first token in seconds (ms values converted). null when not reported.

context_length.description: Context length as stated (e.g. '128K', '650K', '1M'). null when not reported.

power_w.description: Power draw in watts, as stated. null when not reported.

notes.description: Verbatim sentences carrying the extracted signals (max 2) — the audit trail proving where each value came from. null when no structured field was found.

preview.description: The first 300 chars of the post text — always present, the fallback for posts where structured extraction found nothing.

structured.description: true when at least one data field (model / hardware / backend / performance / context_length / power_w) was extracted; false for preview-only items.
